title: Audit installation chain for fresh installs only (replaces D11)
question: D16 requires the P3 design to re-evaluate the 0.7.0 installation and adoption scenarios of D11, B18 and release-gate condition 5 under M15 (0.7.0 does not exist; the package was never published). Which Audit installation chain does P3 build?

options.text: Fresh installs only: the Audit migration with the fixed basename 2026_10_20_000000_create_azguard_audit_log (published under azguard-audit-migrations, not auto-loaded) creates the table; down() drops it (Laravel convention); no adoption or shape check of a pre-existing table; the populated 0.7.0 replays (default/named/published/schema1), tests/Fixtures/Baseline070/Persistence and PopulatedDatabaseTest are removed; I16 = fixed basenames + publishes() + fresh core-only and core+Audit installs (package-loaded, published, named storage) per driver.

Keep revision 2 (D11): up() creates or adopts an existing audit_log after a full shape check, down() keeps data, every #persistence scenario on populated 0.7.0 fixtures per driver with zero row rewrite.

context: P3 design session 2026-10-13. Owner M14/M15 (0.7.0 is no constraint, the package was never published) and M16 (public version is 1.0, everything clean). D11 built adoption only because 0.7.0 named-storage and default migrations created audit_log through core.
decision: A — Fresh installs only: the Audit migration with the fixed basename 2026_10_20_000000_create_azguard_audit_log (published under azguard-audit-migrations, not auto-loaded) creates the table; down() drops it (Laravel convention); no adoption or shape check of a pre-existing table; the populated 0.7.0 replays (default/named/published/schema1), tests/Fixtures/Baseline070/Persistence and PopulatedDatabaseTest are removed; I16 = fixed basenames + publishes() + fresh core-only and core+Audit installs (package-loaded, published, named storage) per driver.
rationale: Owner M16: «Только чистая установка (Recommended)»; no 0.7.0 installation exists (M14, M15).
consequences: Supersedes D11; B18 and release-gate condition 5 read 'fresh installs on every driver' instead of 'populated 0.7.0 fixtures'.

tests/Fixtures/Baseline070/Persistence, tests/Regression/Baseline070/PopulatedDatabaseTest.php and the NoScope parity fixtures that restore 0.7.0 dumps are removed or rewritten to seed through the current API.
Fresh audited installs need one publish step (or one command per named storage); doctor audit.table names it.
knowledge/identities#resources: the Audit migration is 'create' (not create-or-adopt).
